help.sum:
Have it how you want it
Due to the costs of our providers, there are delivery charges on all Uskees orders regardless of quantity. You can choose your preferred postage method at checkout, details in the dropdowns below.
Please note, all deliveries are fully tracked. We also send out orders from Monday to Friday, however arrival timescales are estimates counted from the day of dispatch.
UK delivery
Free Standard shipping on all orders over £90
Standard shipping: 2-4 working days from dispatch, £2.99
Express shipping: 1-2 working days from dispatch, £4.99
EU delivery (except Sweden and Denmark)
Standard shipping via FedEx: 3-5 working days from dispatch, €12,99 (unfortunately we cannot ship to the Canary Islands)
Express shipping via FedEx: 2-4 working days from dispatch, €18,99 (unfortunately we cannot ship to the Canary Islands)
Delivered duty paid. All taxes and duties are included (shown at checkout)

For any query not covered below, please message us via our contact pages.
General
How do I use my discount code?
Enter your code into the discount box at checkout, then select “Apply". If your code isn’t applied at this point, we can’t assign it later. You can however use it for a further order.
Can I amend my order?
Yes. Contact info@uskees.com and we’ll do our best to accommodate your request.
What do I do if I can't access the site or make a purchase?
Any problems with the site, please email info@uskees.com
What do I do if the product I'm looking for is unavailable?
It’s best to email info@uskees.com. That way we can tell you if and when an item’s going to be restocked or help you find a similar item if it was a limited-edition piece. Alternatively, use the ‘notify me...’ button on the product page. This triggers an email to let you know when the item’s back in rotation.
How will I know when my order's been shipped?

Talk to us
To get in touch, please use the contact form below or email info@uskees.com. You can also try our AI Chat Assistant and FAQ page.
We aim to answer all queries within 24 hours, but please note the customer service team's working hours are Monday to Friday, 8am till 4pm GMT.

about.sum:
About us
For a rich and fulfilling life
Uskees is a UK brand that specialises in contemporary workwear and high functioning menswear. Through a core range of overshirts, essentials, suiting and seasonal collections, we emphasise timelessness, utility and integrity. We make lasting, stylish things for your comfort and contentment — for every aspect of a life lived well and to the fullest.
Story
We began in 2019 as an experiment in workwear.
From our studio in Manchester, we put together a new take on the French chore coat, a hardwearing jacket brought to prominence by artisans and labourers of the 20th Century.
Executed with an absolute commitment to integrity, simplicity and invention, what became known as the 3001 overshirt was made to be worn well and lived fully in - understated craftsmanship playfully expressed.
Fast forward to today and the love of heritage, creativity and materials we poured into that 3001 now floods all kinds of fashion genres, styles, fabrics and accessories.

legal.sum:
This Privacy Policy describes how your personal information is collected, used, and shared when you visit or make a purchase from uskees.com (the “Site”).
Personal information we collect
We collect Device Information using the following technologies:
“Log files” track actions occurring on the Site, and collect data including your IP address, browser type, Internet service provider, referring/exit pages, and date/time stamps.
“Web beacons”, “tags”, and “pixels” are electronic files used to record information about how you browse the Site.
Additionally when you make a purchase or attempt to make a purchase through the Site, we collect certain information from you, including your name, billing address, shipping address, payment information (including credit card numbers), email address, and phone number. We refer to this information as “Order Information”. When we talk about “Personal Information” in this Privacy Policy, we are talking both about Device Information and Order Information.

Overview
This website is operated by P & C Retail UK Limited. Throughout the site, the terms “we”, “us” and “our” refer to P & C Retail UK Limited. P & C Retail UK Limited offers this website, including all information, tools and services available from this site to you, the user, conditioned upon your acceptance of all terms, conditions, policies and notices stated here.
By visiting our site and/ or purchasing something from us, you engage in our “Service” and agree to be bound by the following terms and conditions (“Terms of Service”, “Terms”), including those additional terms and conditions and policies referenced herein and/or available by hyperlink. These Terms of Service apply to all users of the site, including without limitation users who are browsers, vendors, customers, merchants, and/ or contributors of content.
Please read these Terms of Service carefully before accessing or…

Refunds and returns
In short...
You can return full-price items to Uskees within 30 days of receiving them, and still receive a full refund.
If you'd like to return an item bought in sale, you must let us know your intention to return it within 14 days of delivery. You must then send it back within 14 days of letting us know.
This is in addition to your legal right to cancel an online order within 14 days of delivery, which applies to all customers in the UK and EU (see Ts & Cs below).
Condition of returns
Please return items unworn, with their labels and repair kits still attached, and in the condition you received them. You're welcome to try items on as you would in a shop. If an item comes back worn, washed or damaged, we may reduce your refund to reflect the loss in value.
Items are your responsibility until they reach us, so we recommend using a tracked service.
This returns policy does not affect your statutory rights.
